description: A channel dedicated to replaying a single recorded capture: passthrough:true skips the mixer (float mix bus, noise floor, other signals) entirely and streams the file's samples straight into VITA-49 packets whenever the tune is inside the 99.9-100.1 MHz range. This is the cheap 'just wrap VITA49 around the IQ data' path -- use it when a channel's only job is to replay one capture, and reserve the general renderer (see replay_range_shift.json) for overlaying multiple signals or a noise floor.
